parameters.name: BackendPort
parameters.description: The port of the origin server. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendPort
parameters.description: The forwarding port. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendProtocol
parameters.description:
The type of the forwarding protocol. Valid values:

*   **tcp**
*   **udp**

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to which the port forwarding rule belongs.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

parameters.name: RealServers
parameters.description: An array that consists of the IP addresses of origin servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-port --frontend-port 55 --frontend-protocol tcp --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-st21zbyq0000 --backend-port 55 --real-servers 1.XX.XX.1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
